anatomicalSystems.name: Neuromuscular system
anatomicalSystems.description: Functional system affected by impaired neurotransmitter release in botulism.

anatomicalSystems.name: Respiratory system
anatomicalSystems.description: Respiratory function can be affected in severe botulism through neuromuscular weakness.

symptoms.name: Flaccid weakness
symptoms.description: Botulism can produce descending flaccid weakness after exposure to botulinum neurotoxin.

symptoms.name: Respiratory muscle weakness
symptoms.description: Severe botulism can impair breathing through neuromuscular weakness.

effects.title: Neuromuscular transmission impairment
effects.description: Botulinum neurotoxin disrupts neurotransmitter release and can produce flaccid weakness.

effects.title: Respiratory neuromuscular involvement
effects.description: Respiratory muscle weakness is a severe physiological consequence of botulism exposure.
